k:瑠.mnemonic: The king (王) will detain (留) any merchant at the border who carries the deep blue stone, and keeps him there until he has bought every piece. Lapis lazuli.
k:瑠.hint: Blue-stone merchants held at the border.

k:宵.mnemonic: Stars sparkle (⺌) above the roof (宀) and the moon that counts the month (月) hangs low beneath it. Everyone is asleep but you. Wee hours (evening, early night).
k:宵.hint: Stars over the roof, all asleep.

k:縫.mnemonic: The needle follows a path (辶) of tiny steps along the cloth, in and out, until it reaches the end (終) of the seam. Sew (stitch, embroider).

k:岬.mnemonic: Walk past the last rice field (田) to where the land makes its exit (出) into the sea. From that point you watch the day (日) rise over the water. Headland (cape, spit, promontory).
k:岬.hint: Where the land runs out to sea.

k:汰.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of water sluices through the pan, carrying off the fat (太) lumps of mud and leaving only the gold dust behind. Washing (sieving, filtering, weeding out).
k:汰.hint: Mud rinsed away, gold dust left.

k:楼.mnemonic: A woman (女) stands on a platform of tree (木) trunks high above the rice (米) store, watching the road for thieves. Watchtower (lookout, high building).
k:楼.hint: Lookout high above the rice store.

k:諾.mnemonic: The young (若) couple ask her father. He strokes his beard for a long minute, and then they hear him say (言): 'Yes.' Consent (assent, agreement).

k:碁.mnemonic: Black and white stone (石) pieces click down onto a wooden board, and capturing a whole group is as sweet (甘) as candy. It is the board game. Go (going).
k:碁.hint: Black and white pieces on a board.

k:某.mnemonic: Somebody hung a bag of sweet (甘) plums on the tree (木) for you and left no note. A certain person, name unknown. So-and-so (one, a certain, that person).
k:某.hint: Plums left by an unnamed someone.

k:沸.mnemonic: Pull (引) the lid off the pot and a small tsunami (氵) of bubbling water heaves up and spits over the rim. Seethe (boil, ferment, uproar).
k:沸.hint: Lid off, water heaving over the rim.

k:泡.mnemonic: The churning tsunami (氵) wraps (包) little pockets of air in thin skins of water, and white froth rides on every wave. Bubbles (foam, suds, froth).
k:泡.hint: Air wrapped in thin skins of water.

k:践.mnemonic: A halberd (戈) lies hidden in the grass and a leg (足) comes down right on it. The shaft flips up and smacks the walker. Tread (step on, trample, practice).
k:践.hint: Foot lands on a hidden shaft.

k:桁.mnemonic: A tree (木) trunk laid across from wall to wall, strong enough for the builders to go (行) back and forth along it. Beam (girder, spar).
k:桁.hint: Trunk laid from wall to wall.

k:鈍.mnemonic: The swords in the barracks (屯) have hung unused for so long that even a gold (金) blade from that rack would not cut butter. Dull (slow, foolish, blunt).

k:渦.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) water spins round and round, and in the middle (中) a hollow opens like the inside of a hood (冂), sucking boats down. Whirlpool (eddy, vortex).
k:渦.hint: Spinning water with a hollow centre.

k:舶.mnemonic: A great white (白) boat (舟) with rows of portholes, crossing the ocean with a thousand passengers aboard. Liner (ship).

k:飽.mnemonic: You eat (食) until you cannot manage one more bite, then ask the waiter to wrap (包) the leftovers. Sated (tired of, bored, satiate).
k:飽.hint: Leftovers boxed up, can't go on.

k:憾.mnemonic: The feeling (感) of what you did sits right on your heartbeat (忄): every thump tells you that you should not have done it. Remorse (regret, be sorry).

k:戴.mnemonic: The farmers come together (共) from the rice field (田), brush the soil (土) off their champion, and set a wreath on his head under an arch of halberd (戈) blades. Be crowned with (live under a ruler, receive, accept).
k:戴.hint: Wreath set on the farmers' champion.

k:丼.mnemonic: A dish as deep as a well (井), holding rice enough for twenty (廾), with the topping dropped in the centre like a stone. Rice bowl (bowl, bowl of food).
k:丼.hint: Deep as a well, topping in the centre.

k:卸.mnemonic: The cart comes to a stop (止) at the warehouse, the clerk puts his stamp (卩) on a hundred crates at once, and shopkeepers carry them off in bulk. Wholesale.
k:卸.hint: A hundred crates stamped at once.

k:郭.mnemonic: The part of the borough (阝) behind its own wall and gate, where people go at night to enjoy (享) themselves. Quarters (enclosure, fortification, red-light district).

k:循.mnemonic: Guards stroll (彳) round the wall in single file, each one following the shield (盾) of the man in front, lap after lap. Sequential (follow).

k:肯.mnemonic: After a month (月) of arguing, both sides stop (止), look at each other and nod: yes, that will do. Agreement (consent, comply with).
k:肯.hint: The arguing ends with a nod.

k:膨.mnemonic: Ten (十) beans (豆) planted in wet soil (土) grow fat within a month (月), split their skins and push out roots like whiskers (彡). Swell (get fat, thick).

k:貼.mnemonic: A club member (員) dips a divining rod (卜) in glue and uses it to stick posters onto every wall in town. Paste (stick, apply).

k:醜.mnemonic: A ghost (鬼) climbs out of the wine jar (酉), bloated and purple-faced after a century of soaking. Even the other ghosts look away. Ugly (unclean, shame, bad looking).

k:虹.mnemonic: After the rain an insect (虫) looks up at a huge piece of construction (工) across the sky: a bridge built in seven colours. Rainbow.

k:怨.mnemonic: Every evening (夕) he takes out the old insult and presses it like a stamp (卩) onto his heart (心) again, so that the mark never fades. Grudge (show resentment, be jealous).

k:藍.mnemonic: The dyer has to oversee (監) vats of crushed flowers (艹) and leaves for days until the cloth comes out a deep blue. Indigo.
k:藍.hint: Dyer watching vats turn cloth blue.
